title: Mega Mesa Retreat: Heated Pool, Spa & Pickle Ball
description:
Welcome to your ultimate Mesa getaway! This 8-bedroom retreat features a heated pool, relaxing spa, private pickleball court, pool table, shuffleboard, and tons of games for all ages. Perfect for large groups, family reunions, or corporate stays. Enjoy spacious living areas, a fully stocked kitchen, and resort-style outdoor fun—your private Arizona oasis awaits!

 The space 
Escape to a 5,400 sq ft private resort where pickleball matches, pool days, and late-night arcade battles all happen without ever leaving home. Kids get a climbing wall & life-size yard games; adults get a bar, hot tub soaks, and sunset cocktails on the 2nd-floor deck. Perfect for big families, friend groups, golf trips & desert getaways where you want to park the car and just play.

Outside, you’ve got a heated pool, hot tub, full pickleball court, mini putt-putt, and life-size yard games. Inside, a massive game room with bar, ping pong, pool table, shuffleboard, foosball and standup arcades keeps the competition going long after the sun goes down.

🏡 The Home
Designed for large groups, this spacious home features:
• 8 comfortable bedrooms across 2 levels
• 4 full bathrooms
• 5,400 sq ft of living space so everyone can hang together and find a quiet corner
• Open living / gaming area that flows easily to the backyard
• Fully stocked kitchen with plenty of prep space for feeding a crowd
Whether you’re traveling with kids, couples, or a mix of both, there’s room for everyone to unpack and relax.

Bedroom Layout:
Bedroom 1: King Bed
Bedroom 2: King Bed 
Bedroom 3: King Bed 
Bedroom 4: King Bed 
Bedroom 5: King Bed 
Bedroom 6: King Bed 
Bedroom 7: Two Queen Beds
Bedroom 8: One Full-Over-Full Bunk Beds 
Extra Sleeping: Queen-Sized Air Mattress, Pak n Play

🎉 Epic Game Rooms & Indoor Fun
Rain or shine, the fun never stops:
• Game room with bar – perfect home base for snacks and drinks
• Ping pong table
• Pool table
• Shuffleboard
• Foosball
• Standup arcade games for that nostalgic “just one more round” feeling
• Kid’s climbing wall that turns downtime into adventure
This is the hangout spot your group will naturally gravitate to every night.

🌴 Backyard Resort
Step outside into your own private playground:
• Heated pool (optional, $125 per night fee) – enjoy it year-round
• Hot tub – ideal for unwinding after long days in the sun
• Full pickleball court – paddles and balls provided; just bring your competitive spirit
• Fire pit surrounded by Adirondack chairs – s’mores, stories, and stargazing
• Mini putt-putt green
• Life-size checkers & Twister
• Cornhole
• Plenty of lounge chairs and umbrellas for sunny days and shady breaks
Everything is laid out so you can bounce effortlessly between pool, court, and games—no driving, no day passes, just pure vacation.

Please note: The home does not have a central speaker system, so we recommend bringing your own Bluetooth speaker if you’d like to play music during your stay.

☀️ Second-Floor Deck
Head up to the 2nd-floor deck/patio for:
• Morning coffee with a view of the yard
• Sunset cocktails while watching the last pickleball match of the day
• A quiet spot to read or catch up on emails before rejoining the fun
It’s the perfect overlook for group photos and those “we’re really on vacation” moments.

✨ Why You’ll Love It
• Space for everyone – 8 bedrooms and multiple hangout zones
• Resort-style amenities – all the fun of a hotel, none of the crowds
• Endless entertainment on-site – no need to entertain kids off-property every day
• Central Mesa location – quick access to dining, golf, Spring Training, ASU, Tempe & Old Town Scottsdale

🚗 Popular Things To Do (Driving Distance)
(Times approximate, based on typical traffic – tweak if you want them exact.)
• Cubs Spring Training (Sloan Park): ~13 minutes
• Tempe Marketplace: ~15 minutes
• Downtown Mesa: ~15 minutes
• Downtown Gilbert: ~19 minutes
• Arizona State University (ASU): ~19 minutes
• Old Town Scottsdale: ~22 minutes
• Scottsdale Fashion Square: ~23 minutes
• Bell Bank Park: ~26 minutes
• Footprint Center & Chase Field (Suns / D-backs): ~29 minutes
• State Farm Stadium (Cardinals): ~45–50 minutes
Nearby Airports
• Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX): ~20 minutes
• Phoenix-Mesa Gateway (AZA): ~25–30 minutes

Book your stay and turn your Mesa trip into a full-on private resort experience. From first serve on the pickleball court to last laughs around the fire pit, this is where your group’s favorite vacation memories get made.

 Guest access 
Our guests have full access to this entire home during their stay. We only ask that you refrain from removing or tampering with pool equipment to ensure no damage and the pool will remain clean during your stay. The home is keyless entry for a smooth check-in both afternoon and night!

 Other things to note 
Here are a few additional services our guests usually take advantage of along with the rates. Please submit any requests at least 1 week prior to check-in.

1. Early Check-In - $200 (when available)
2. Late Check-Out - $200 (when available)
3. Pool Heating - $125/night *Heated Spa/Jacuzzi is included with your reservation.
4. Daily Housekeeping - $200 for two hours. *Includes bathrooms, beds (sheet and towel change upon advance request), kitchen, and common living spaces. Please submit any special requests in advance.
5. Pet Cleaning and Deodorizing (dogs only) - $125 per pet for the duration of your stay.

In-home Concierge Services:

**Please contact us at least 1 week prior to your stay for any special occasions (birthdays, anniversaries, Bachelor(ette) stays, etc) 

1. Grocery Delivery 
2. Private Chef 
3. Electronics/Consumer Goods 
4. Private In-Home Massage 
5. Baby Equipment Rental 

Our neighbors are our friends! We love that we can share our home with our guests and ask that everyone abide by the quiet hours from 10 pm-7 am so that we can continue to serve our guests without disrupting our great neighborhood. Please note, the house is located adjacent to a main/busy road and road noise can be heard from the property.

House Rules and Notes:
• No parties or events of any kind allowed on property
• Must be 25 years of age or older to rent. Renting person must stay in the home throughout the reservation.
• No smoking
• Check-in time is 4 PM (this time is strict)
• Check-out time is 10 AM (this time is strict)
• Early check-in and late check-out (if available, fees apply)
• Pets are allowed with exceptions (pet fees apply)
Due To A New City Ordinance:
• All reservations will go through a verification process
• Please be sure your full name is entered on your reservation when booking
• IDs will be requested for verification after booking
• We report and prosecute all credit card fraud

We do have members of our team who may visit the property during your stay. They include landscaping and pool maintenance crews. These visits can not be rescheduled or delayed. 

This property is managed by Sunstone Vacation.
